verdict.rationale: Asana documents AI Studio no-code automations, pre-built AI agents and custom AI Teammates that work inside workflows, plus rule actions and webhooks. Intake integrations such as Sentry, Jira and GitLab can feed bugs and tasks into those workflows. This makes AI-driven triage plausible, but no evidence explicitly shows AI automatically triaging or prioritizing incoming work. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI triage/prioritization of incoming bugs and tasks (e.g., auto-setting priority, assignee or routing), concrete AI Studio triage examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
